profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Block
profile.summary:
I am a Staff Backend Engineer at Block and a specialist in Node.js, Golang, SQL and Java. I manage a team of 13 incredible engineers, but am still very much hands-on myself as I always have, and will, want to stay close to the code.

I have an incredible 2-year-old daughter and a Bernese Mountain Dog (Gustav) who eats more than me!
